mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN target_kind='GROUP' THEN target_id::bigint END AS group_binding_id, requester_kind, CASE WHEN requester_kind='END_USER' THEN 'end_user:'||requester_end_user_id::text WHEN requester_kind='SYSTEM' THEN 'system:'||requester_system_principal_id END AS requester_ref, source_session_id AS origin_session_id,source_message_id AS origin_event_id FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId}

SELECT s.id AS system_agent_run_id,s.agent_id, 'system-agent-config:'||s.agent_id::text||':'||coalesce(s.version::text,'draft') AS configuration_ref, 'system-agent-invocation:'||s.id::text AS invocation_ref,a.purpose,s.debug, j.agent_id::bigint AS responsibility_agent_id,j.end_user_id AS source_author_id, CASE WHEN j.source_target_kind='GROUP' THEN j.integration_id ELSE original.integration_id END AS integration_id, j.group_binding_id,j.source_session_id AS origin_session_id,j.source_event_id AS origin_event_id,e.root_input_id,original.business_scope_id FROM public.nw_platform_system_agent_runs s JOIN public.nw_platform_system_agents a ON a.id=s.agent_id LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs j ON j.tenant_id=s.tenant_id::text AND j.system_run_id=s.id::text LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events e ON e.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND e.target_kind=j.source_target_kind AND e.target_id=j.source_target_id AND e.session_id=j.source_session_id AND e.event_id=j.source_event_id AND e.agent_id=j.agent_id AND (j.source_target_kind='GROUP' OR e.end_user_id=j.end_user_id) LEFT JOIN public.nw_chat_sessions original ON original.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND original.session_id=j.source_session_id WHERE s.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND s.id=#{systemRunId}

SELECT COALESCE(auth.snapshot -> 'grant_chain' ->> 'owner_kind','tenant') AS source_owner_kind, CASE WHEN auth.snapshot IS NULL THEN b.tenant_id::bigint ELSE (auth.snapshot -> 'grant_chain' ->> 'owner_tenant_id')::bigint END AS source_owner_tenant_id, (auth.snapshot -> 'grant_chain' ->> 'definition_id')::bigint AS agent_definition_id, b.frozen_member ->> 'agent_definition_version' AS agent_definition_version, (b.frozen_member ->> 'agent_revision_id')::bigint AS agent_revision_id, (b.frozen_member ->> 'agent_revision')::integer AS agent_revision, (auth.snapshot ->> 'deployment_id')::bigint AS deployment_id, (auth.snapshot ->> 'deployment_revision')::bigint AS deployment_revision, (auth.snapshot ->> 'grant_id')::bigint AS grant_id, (auth.snapshot ->> 'grant_revision')::bigint AS grant_revision FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings b CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.scope_snapshot -> 'authorizations' -> b.actor_agent_id AS snapshot) auth WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.run_id=#{runId} AND b.actor_agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS text) UNION ALL SELECT 'platform' AS source_owner_kind,NULL::bigint AS source_owner_tenant_id,NULL::bigint AS agent_definition_id, s.source_data ->> 'prompt_source_ref' AS agent_definition_version, NULL::bigint AS agent_revision_id,NULL::integer AS agent_revision, NULL::bigint AS deployment_id,NULL::bigint AS deployment_revision,NULL::bigint AS grant_id,NULL::bigint AS grant_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs r JOIN public.nw_system_agent_runtime_capability_sources s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.session_id=r.session_id AND s.agent_id=r.agent_id AND s.end_user_id=r.end_user_id AND s.input_id=r.input_id JOIN public.nw_runtime_host_owners h ON h.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND h.session_id=s.session_id AND h.agent_id=s.agent_id AND h.end_user_id=s.end_user_id AND h.target_kind=r.target_kind AND h.target_id=r.target_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.run_id=#{runId} AND r.agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS text) AND r.target_kind='AGENT' AND r.target_id=r.agent_id AND r.requester_kind='SYSTEM' AND r.origin_ref=s.source_data ->> 'run_id' AND NULLIF(s.source_data ->> 'prompt_source_ref','') IS NOT NULL

SELECT hop.ordinality::integer AS ordinal,(hop.value ->> 'grant_id')::bigint AS grant_id, (hop.value ->> 'revision')::bigint AS revision,hop.value ->> 'grantor_kind' AS grantor_kind, (hop.value ->> 'grantor_tenant_id')::bigint AS grantor_tenant_id, (hop.value ->> 'target_tenant_id')::bigint AS target_tenant_id, (hop.value ->> 'parent_grant_id')::bigint AS parent_grant_id, (hop.value ->> 'parent_grant_revision')::bigint AS parent_grant_revision, (hop.value ->> 'relation_ref')::bigint AS relation_ref, (hop.value ->> 'relation_revision')::bigint AS relation_revision FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings b CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(b.scope_snapshot -> 'authorizations' -> b.actor_agent_id -> 'grant_chain' -> 'hops') WITH ORDINALITY hop(value,ordinality) WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.run_id=#{runId} AND b.actor_agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS text) ORDER BY hop.ordinality

SELECT usage_id,ordinal,grant_id,revision,grantor_kind,grantor_tenant_id,target_tenant_id, parent_grant_id,parent_grant_revision,relation_ref,relation_revision FROM public.nw_usage_event_grant_hops WHERE
tenant_id IN #{tenant} AND usage_id IN #{id} FALSE ORDER BY usage_id,ordinal

mapper.select: SELECT stream_revision FROM public.nw_usage_publication_state WHERE stream_id=1
SELECT published_cursor FROM public.nw_usage_publication_state WHERE stream_id=1
mapper.sql: SELECT e.tenant_id,e.usage_id,e.event_id,e.publication_cursor,e.published_at, u.event_id AS source_event_id,u.origin_kind,u.actor_ref,u.responsibility_ref,u.deployment_id,u.integration_id,u.business_scope_id,u.agent_definition_version, u.source_owner_kind,u.source_owner_tenant_id,u.agent_definition_id,u.agent_revision_id,u.agent_revision, u.deployment_revision,u.grant_id,u.grant_revision,u.measurement_unit, u.group_binding_id,u.requester_kind,u.requester_ref,u.origin_session_id,u.origin_event_id,u.responsibility_agent_id,u.system_agent_run_id,u.system_agent_configuration_ref,u.system_agent_invocation_ref, u.event_type,u.usage_event_kind,u.report_revision,u.usage_snapshot_revision, CASE WHEN original.id IS NOT NULL THEN original.tenant_id::text||':'||original.event_id END AS adjustment_of_event_id, u.invocation_id,u.attempt_id,u.request_id,u.root_input_id,u.session_id,u.run_id,u.end_user_id,u.channel_id, u.agent_id,u.provider,u.model,u.quantity,u.pricing_model_id,u.pricing_model_revision,u.image_count,u.video_count,u.characters,u.duration_seconds,u.tokens,u.prompt_tokens,u.completion_tokens,u.usage_source, u.amount_status,COALESCE(u.total_amount,u.total_amount_cents::numeric) AS amount_cents, u.currency,u.exchange_rate_to_cny,u.occurred_at,u.ingested_at FROM (SELECT tenant_id,usage_id,event_id,publication_cursor,published_at FROM public.nw_usage_publication_events UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id,usage_id,event_id,NULL::bigint AS publication_cursor,NULL::timestamptz AS published_at FROM public.nw_usage_publication_pending) e JOIN public.nw_usage_events u ON u.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND u.id=e.usage_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_usage_events original ON original.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND original.id=u.adjustment_of_event_id

WITH facts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT FROM () source WHERE ), base AS ( SELECT FROM facts WHERE usage_event_kind='measured' UNION ALL SELECT FROM facts r WHERE r.usage_event_kind='usage_report' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facts m WHERE m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND m.attempt_id=r.attempt_id AND m.usage_event_kind='measured') AND r.usage_id=(SELECT x.usage_id FROM facts x WHERE x.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND x.attempt_id=r.attempt_id AND x.usage_event_kind='usage_report' ORDER BY x.report_revision DESC,x.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1) ), effective AS ( SELECT , CASE WHEN e.event_type='llm.chat' AND e.attempt_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.prompt_tokens,e.prompt_tokens) ELSE e.prompt_tokens END AS effective_prompt, CASE WHEN e.event_type='llm.chat' AND e.attempt_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.completion_tokens,e.completion_tokens) ELSE e.completion_tokens END AS effective_completion, c.effective_amount,c.effective_currency,c.effective_rate,c.effective_status, COALESCE(a.gaps,0) AS gaps,COALESCE(a.delta,0) AS delta FROM base e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (array_agg(x.prompt_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(x.report_revision,x.usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,x.usage_id DESC) FILTER(WHERE x.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND x.usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS prompt_tokens, (array_agg(x.completion_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(x.report_revision,x.usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,x.usage_id DESC) FILTER(WHERE x.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL AND x.usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS completion_tokens FROM facts x WHERE x.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND x.attempt_id=e.attempt_id AND x.usage_event_kind IN ('measured','usage_report')) p ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT FROM facts r WHERE r.adjustment_of_event_id=e.event_id AND r.usage_event_kind='reconciliation' ORDER BY r.ingested_at DESC,r.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN r.usage_id IS NULL THEN e.amount_cents ELSE r.amount_cents END AS effective_amount, CASE WHEN r.usage_id IS NULL THEN e.currency ELSE r.currency END AS effective_currency, CASE WHEN r.usage_id IS NULL THEN e.exchange_rate_to_cny ELSE r.exchange_rate_to_cny END AS effective_rate, CASE WHEN r.usage_id IS NULL AND e.event_type IN ('llm.chat','llm.embedding') AND e.usage_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROVIDER_REPORTED' THEN 'unresolved' WHEN r.usage_id IS NULL THEN e.amount_status ELSE r.amount_status END AS effective_status) c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN x.amount_status='priced' THEN x.amount_cents* CASE WHEN x.currency='CNY' THEN 1 ELSE x.exchange_rate_to_cny END END) AS delta, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE x.amount_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'priced' OR x.amount_cents IS NULL OR (x.currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'CNY' AND x.exchange_rate_to_cny IS NULL)) AS gaps FROM facts x WHERE x.adjustment_of_event_id=e.event_id AND x.usage_event_kind='adjustment') a ON true ), totals AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type='request') AS request_count, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type<>'request' AND NOT(event_type IN ('media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND quantity=0 AND amount_status='not_applicable')) AS invocation_count, SUM(effective_prompt) AS prompt_tokens,SUM(effective_completion) AS completion_tokens, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (event_type='llm.chat' AND (effective_prompt IS NULL OR effective_completion IS NULL)) OR (event_type='llm.embedding' AND effective_prompt IS NULL) OR (event_type IN ('media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND usage_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROVIDER_REPORTED' AND NOT(quantity=0 AND amount_status='not_applicable')) OR (event_type NOT IN ('request','llm.chat','llm.embedding','media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND quantity IS NULL)) AS unknown_usage_count, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type<>'request' AND NOT(event_type IN ('media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND quantity=0 AND amount_status='not_applicable') AND (effective_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'priced' OR effective_amount IS NULL OR (effective_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'CNY' AND effective_rate IS NULL) OR gaps>0)) AS unresolved_cost_count FROM effective ), costs AS ( SELECT 'CNY'::text AS currency,SUM(effective_amount* CASE WHEN effective_currency='CNY' THEN 1 ELSE effective_rate END + delta) AS amount_cents FROM effective WHERE event_type<>'request' AND effective_status='priced' AND effective_amount IS NOT NULL AND (effective_currency='CNY' OR effective_rate IS NOT NULL) AND gaps=0 HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ) SELECT totals.request_count,totals.invocation_count,totals.prompt_tokens,totals.completion_tokens, totals.unknown_usage_count,totals.unresolved_cost_count,costs.currency,costs.amount_cents FROM totals LEFT JOIN costs ON true
